title: Typographic test wall
slide_intent: Test a family with varied content because a corporate face must handle names, codes, numbers and prose.
strategic_value: Diverse proofs can expose weaknesses before Lufthansa uses the type across its organization.
demonstration: A tall collage of printed tests combines large letters, travel phrases, type labels, numbers and small text.
practical_value: Build a proof set from realistic content rather than a single alphabet.

content_islands.name: Proof collage
content_islands.spec: Preserve the dense mix of different scales and reading tasks through the vertical display.
